label: Required times flow backward
subgoals: Take the minimum over outgoing arcs of required time minus delay
Process vertices in reverse topological order

label: Slack at a vertex
subgoals: Subtract arrival from required time at each vertex
Read negative slack as a violating path through the vertex
Compute arc slack to find the critical fanin

label: The critical subgraph
subgoals: Set the required time to the latest endpoint arrival
Collect the vertices with zero slack
Read the size of the critical subgraph as how concentrated the problem is
